$description: Closed assetRole vocabulary. Every media field in a PageSpec names one role. The source is Glaze by Raycast, a real live commercial product. Every role carries `availability`: reference-only roles may appear only in `mode: reference` PageSpecs and name generation-safe substitutes; blocked-for-generation roles are protected third-party or personal content (real trademarks, real people, live endpoints) that never appear in a generated page; generation-safe roles (placeholder, generated, user-supplied) may appear in `mode: generated`. verify_all.py pins each role to its policy value AND its availability (not just enum membership).
globalRules: AI generation must never reproduce Glaze or Raycast logos, marks or app icons.
Never use real users' avatars, names, or real app icons or screenshots.
Never copy the source site's marketing copy; example PageSpec content is placeholder text (reference mode) or original copy for a fictional brand (generated mode).
Asset files are not shipped in this repo; assetRef values are host-resolved ids (placeholder:, user: or generated: in generated mode).
A generated page never links to the source's hosts (glaze.app, raycast.com, api.glazeapp.com, ...); use relative paths, # anchors or reserved .example / .invalid hosts.

app.icon.description: Squircle icon inside an app card.
app.icon.guidance: Generate neutral abstract placeholder art (flat gradient or simple shape). Never reproduce a real app's icon or a Glaze/Raycast mark.
app.icon.generatedModeGuidance: Observed files are real third-party apps' icons. A generated page uses generated abstract placeholder art, never one of those files.

app.icon-generated.description: Generated abstract icon for an app card in a generated page.
app.icon-generated.guidance: Flat gradient or simple shape; never a real app's icon.

article.image.description: Screenshots inside blog posts and release notes.
article.image.guidance: Real product UI of the source. Do not fabricate or paraphrase it; reuse only with a licence, or use a neutral placeholder.
article.image.generatedModeGuidance: Real screenshots of the source product. Generated pages use screenshots the user supplies or generated imagery.

avatar.person.description: Round author avatar on an app card.
avatar.person.guidance: Use a synthetic, clearly generic avatar (initial on a flat colour, or abstract shape). Never use or imitate a real user's photo, and never use a real person's name.
avatar.person.generatedModeGuidance: Observed files are real people's photos. A generated page uses neutral placeholder avatars.

avatar.placeholder.description: Neutral placeholder avatar (initial on a flat colour or abstract shape).
avatar.placeholder.guidance: Never a photo, never a real person's likeness.
avatar.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Replaces avatar.person and person.photo in generated mode.

badge.award.derivedFrom: showcase.persona-tabs tabs[].apps[].award enum (the medal image follows the tier)
badge.award.description: Gold, silver or bronze award medal after an app name.
badge.award.guidance: Reuse the exact shipped medal or omit the badge. Do not redraw.
badge.award.generatedModeGuidance: The source's award medals belong to its own awards programme. A generated page may show only generated medals for its own programme.

badge.award-generated.description: Generated medal for the generated brand's own programme.
badge.award-generated.guidance: Generate new medal art; do not reproduce the source's gold, silver or bronze medals.

brand.app-icon.guidance: Reuse the shipped file exactly. AI generation must never reproduce or approximate the Glaze or Raycast logo or app icon.
brand.app-icon.generatedModeGuidance: The source product's app icon. Never reproduce, redraw or imitate it; use a neutral placeholder icon or the user's own.

brand.app-icon-placeholder.description: Neutral placeholder app icon for the generated brand.
brand.app-icon-placeholder.guidance: Generate a flat geometric icon. It must not resemble the source product's icon.
brand.app-icon-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use when the user supplies no icon.

brand.app-icon-user-supplied.description: The generated brand's own app icon, supplied by the user.
brand.app-icon-user-supplied.guidance: Use the exact supplied file; never the source icon.
brand.app-icon-user-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: Preferred whenever the user provides an icon.

brand.wordmark.description: Glaze wordmark SVG in the nav pill and mobile panel.
brand.wordmark.guidance: Reuse the shipped file exactly. Never redraw, recolour, restyle or invent a wordmark. If the host has no licence to ship it, omit it.
brand.wordmark.generatedModeGuidance: The source brand's wordmark. A generated site is a different brand: use a neutral placeholder wordmark or the file the user supplies.

brand.wordmark-placeholder.description: Neutral placeholder wordmark for the generated brand.
brand.wordmark-placeholder.guidance: Generate a plain text wordmark or geometric monogram. It must not resemble the source wordmark (no lettering style, colour or shape taken from it).
brand.wordmark-placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Use when the user supplies no wordmark.

brand.wordmark-user-supplied.description: The generated brand's own wordmark, supplied by the user.
brand.wordmark-user-supplied.guidance: Use the exact supplied file. Never redraw, recolour or substitute the source wordmark.
brand.wordmark-user-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: Preferred whenever the user provides a wordmark.

cover.image.description: Blog and store cover artwork of the source (its own brand imagery and its publishers' screenshots).
cover.image.guidance: Generate new artwork in the design system's palette; never reuse, trace or restyle the source's covers.
cover.image.generatedModeGuidance: Cover and featured imagery of the source. Generated pages use generated or user-supplied imagery.

embed.video.description: Third-party video embed target (YouTube) opened by the overlay.
embed.video.guidance: External domains are intentionally not cloned. Examples use a placeholder URL. Do not point generated pages at the live source site's videos.
embed.video.generatedModeGuidance: Live third-party video endpoints of the source (its YouTube videos). Blocked: a generated page may only point at a video the user supplies.

logo.partner.description: Company marks on the team tab.
logo.partner.guidance: Real third-party trademarks. Use only the exact shipped glyph for a company that has agreed, otherwise generic placeholder shapes. Never invent or alter a company mark.
logo.partner.generatedModeGuidance: Real third-party trademarks shown on the source. Blocked: use an explicit placeholder logo or a logo the user supplies for their own customers.

logo.placeholder.description: Explicit placeholder logo for a customer, partner or sponsor in a generated page.
logo.placeholder.guidance: A plain labelled placeholder shape; never a real company's mark.
logo.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: Replaces logo.partner and logo.sponsor in generated mode.

logo.sponsor.description: A sponsor's wordmark (a real third-party company).
logo.sponsor.guidance: A real company's trademark. Never create or reproduce it; use an explicit placeholder.
logo.sponsor.generatedModeGuidance: A real sponsor's mark. Blocked: use a placeholder logo or one the user supplies for their own sponsor.

logo.user-supplied.description: A logo the user supplies for their own customer, partner or sponsor.
logo.user-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: Preferred over the placeholder whenever the user provides a logo.

mark.third-party.description: A third-party product mark shown as a glyph in a plan row.
mark.third-party.guidance: A real trademark. Never reproduce it.
mark.third-party.generatedModeGuidance: A real product mark. Blocked: generated plan rows use the check glyph.

media.generated.description: Generated imagery for covers and in-page images (abstract, in the design system's palette).
media.generated.guidance: Do not reproduce, trace or restyle any source image.
media.generated.generatedModeGuidance: Replaces the reference-only cover, article and screenshot roles.

media.user-supplied.description: Images or screenshots the user supplies for their own product.
media.user-supplied.guidance: Use only the supplied file; never one captured from the source site.
media.user-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: Use for product screenshots and photography.

particle.app-icon.derivedFrom: cta.download-icon.particlePoolRef (host-resolved pool id, no direct asset field)
particle.app-icon.description: Pool of 17 app icons thrown by the click burst.
particle.app-icon.guidance: Reuse the shipped pool, or ship the burst with generic placeholder squares. Never generate lookalikes of real app icons.
particle.app-icon.generatedModeGuidance: The source's pool of 17 app icons thrown by the click burst. A generated page ships the burst with generic placeholder squares (particle.placeholder).

particle.placeholder.description: Generic squares or shapes thrown by the click burst on a generated page.
particle.placeholder.guidance: Generate simple abstract shapes; never lookalikes of real app icons.
particle.placeholder.generatedModeGuidance: The only particle pool a generated page may reference (particlePoolRef must be a placeholder: ref).
particle.placeholder.derivedFrom: cta.download-icon / cta.download-page / cta.download-compact / content.not-found-block particlePoolRef (a placeholder: ref in generated mode)

person.photo.description: Portraits of real named people (the awards jury).
person.photo.guidance: Real people's likeness. Never generate, reuse or imitate a real person's photo; use a neutral placeholder.
person.photo.generatedModeGuidance: Real named people. Blocked: use neutral placeholder avatars.

screenshot.app.description: Screenshots of third-party apps in the store strip.
screenshot.app.guidance: Real third-party app UIs. Never fabricate or reproduce them.
screenshot.app.generatedModeGuidance: Real third-party app screenshots. Generated pages use user-supplied or generated imagery for their own apps.

screenshot.feature.description: Product screenshot in a feature card (desktop and mobile crops).
screenshot.feature.guidance: Real product UI. Do not fabricate or paraphrase it. Reuse the exact shipped file, or use a neutral wireframe placeholder clearly marked as such.
screenshot.feature.generatedModeGuidance: Screenshots of the source product's UI. A generated page uses screenshots the user supplies for their own product, or generated imagery.

video.awards-hero.description: The awards hero loop (an abstract liquid-metal brand mark in motion).
video.awards-hero.guidance: The source's own brand video. Reuse only the supplied file; never recreate or imitate it for another brand.
video.awards-hero.generatedModeGuidance: The source brand's video. Generated pages use a video the user supplies.

video.hero-loop.description: Autoplay muted intro loop in the hero.
video.hero-loop.guidance: Reuse the shipped file or a static poster. Do not synthesise footage of the real product.
video.hero-loop.generatedModeGuidance: The source's own product video. A generated page uses a video the user supplies.

video.user-supplied.description: Video the user supplies for their own product.
video.user-supplied.guidance: Use only the supplied file; never the source's videos and never fabricated footage of real products or people.
video.user-supplied.generatedModeGuidance: The only video role a generated page may use.

modes.reference: A clone or fidelity-validation page for the SOURCE brand. Only the roles each section field lists as referenceRoles; reference-only roles are available, generation-safe-only roles are not.
modes.generated: A new page for ANY OTHER brand. Only generation-safe roles, only the generatedRoles each field lists; no text, alt text, label, route or URL may name the source brand (source-protected.json), reuse verbatim source copy, use a source host or point at a source asset (protected-assets.json); assetRef values must be placeholder:, user: or generated: refs.

assetRefPolicy.note: In generated mode every assetRef, logoAssetRef, particlePoolRef (any key ending in Ref) must match. Reference mode accepts any host-resolved id.

sourceBrand.note: Matched case-insensitively against every string of a generated PageSpec (headings, labels, alt text, hrefs, refs, route, head). The word 'glaze' is also an English word; a generated page must not use it. People, companies, hosts and verbatim copy are in assets/source-protected.json.

observedAssets.$description: Every file of the source project's public/ tree (assets/protected-assets.json) mapped to exactly one role by the FIRST matching rule below (paths relative to public/). 'none:*' entries are not PageSpec assets. verify_all.py check 7c fails when a file matches no rule or a rule names an unknown role, and records the per-role counts.

rules.note: Self-hosted font files: referenced by tokens (typography), never by a PageSpec role.
Favicons and touch icon: document head, not a PageSpec asset.
Open Graph share image: document head, not a PageSpec asset.
